physicalEvidence.summary: The final 2025 CARoL paper identifies Wang as corresponding author and lead Hu as GMU ECE; current lab roster establishes Wang’s advising, corroborated by the official indexed 2026 Xiao CV (direct file retrieval unavailable). PPO policies learned in Chrono for concrete/grass are adapted using learned state-transition similarity to a physical rocky testbed. After20manually driven data-collection trials, policy adaptation uses10iterations of8real navigation trials, about130minutes. Final comparison uses5trials per model; the system executes continuous speed/steering commands. CarRacing/LunarLander are separate simulation tests. Initial physical failures include boundary departure, getting stuck and rollover. The work is jointly supported by MICO and RobotiXX; exclusive platform ownership and visitor access are not inferred.
